text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear pro-driverless opening and thesis","quality":"thesis clarity","description":"The essay states its position directly and previews the main reasons it will argue."},{"evidence":"separate safety and environmental body paragraphs","quality":"organization","description":"The essay groups ideas into distinct paragraphs that make the argument easier to follow."},{"evidence":"\"sensors seemingly everywhere\" and \"real life, real time model\"","quality":"development","description":"The essay explains its points with more elaboration rather than only asserting them."},{"evidence":"\"From the safety features, to the environemntal gain\"","quality":"argument breadth","description":"The essay supports its position with more than one line of reasoning."},{"evidence":"\"Now, there are flaws...\"","quality":"counterargument awareness","description":"The essay acknowledges a drawback and then addresses it instead of ignoring the other side."},{"evidence":"\"Driverless cars are the way of the future\"","quality":"conclusion","description":"The essay ends with a clear wrap-up that restates the claim and leaves a final impression."}]}
